transcript.text: Elena, I need to report an equipment issue. My airflow inspection of Oven 2 found a temporarily restricted filter, which limits a safe qualified load to exactly 240 brackets until the filter is replaced. I've confirmed the replacement will take exactly 2 hours. I should note that the maintenance log has not yet been updated with this information.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Local traveler must be updated to reflect the requirement of 5 witness coupons per furnace load and hardness testing before release.
Maintenance log must be updated with the restricted filter finding and the 2-hour replacement time before the run proceeds.
Filter replacement must be completed within the 2-hour window between the first and second 240-unit loads so Oven 2 is fully qualified for the second load.
